response.original_title: STAR WARS: Revenge of the Sith Extended Edition
response.overview: STAR WARS: Revenge of the Sith Extended Edition 3.0 is a fan-edited cut of Revenge of the Sith that includes: Revenge of the Sith with four deleted scenes, The Clone Wars S7:E9-12, A scene from Tales of the Empire S1:E4, A scene from Tales of the Jedi S1:E5, A scene from Tales of the Jedi S1:E6
